from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, Literal

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its assigned cause-of-action category from the task's given list."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    category: Optional[Literal['侵犯公民人身权利,民主权利罪', '行政行为-行政给付', '行政行为-行政征收', '行政行为-行政撤销', '执行案由-先予执行', '执行案由-行政非诉执行']] = Field(description="The cause-of-action category this document belongs to, based on the task's given list. None if the document doesn't match any given category")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
